description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Layout' that provides the main application shell for a web app. It includes a responsive sidebar navigation, top bar with user info and theme toggle, breadcrumb trail, and accessibility features. It also contains internal helper components and functions for navigation and breadcrumb building.

methods.name: buildBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Constructs breadcrumb trail based on current route path.

methods.name: toTitle
methods.description: Converts route segments into human-readable labels.
